tools.name: get_realtime_metrics
tools.description: Get real-time queue and agent metrics from Amazon Connect including agents online, available, on call, and contacts in queue.

instance_id.description: Amazon Connect instance ID (optional, uses default)

queue_ids.description: Comma-separated queue IDs to filter by (optional)

routing_profile_ids.description: Comma-separated routing profile IDs to filter by (optional)

tools.name: get_historical_metrics
tools.description: Get historical Amazon Connect performance metrics grouped by agent, queue, or routing profile.

instance_id.description: Amazon Connect instance ID (optional, uses default)

tools.name: get_agent_states
tools.description: Get current Amazon Connect agent states, including active queues, contacts, and time spent in state.

instance_id.description: Amazon Connect instance ID (optional, uses default)

queue_id.description: Optional queue ID to scope the results

tools.name: search_contacts
tools.description: Search Amazon Connect contact records by time range, queue, agent, and duration filters.

instance_id.description: Amazon Connect instance ID (optional, uses default)

tools.name: get_contact_detail
tools.description: Get merged Amazon Connect contact metadata, attributes, and recording information for a contact.

instance_id.description: Amazon Connect instance ID (optional, uses default)

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Get Amazon Connect Contact Lens transcript, issue, category, or sensitive data segments for a contact.

instance_id.description: Amazon Connect instance ID (optional, uses default)

segment_types.description: Comma-separated list from TRANSCRIPT, ISSUES, CATEGORIES, SENSITIVE_DATA

tools.name: keyword_search
tools.description: Search contacts by a keyword in Contact Lens transcripts.

instance_id.description: Amazon Connect instance ID (optional, uses default)

tools.name: get_recording_url
tools.description: Generate a pre-signed S3 URL for an Amazon Connect call recording when a recording exists.

instance_id.description: Amazon Connect instance ID (optional, uses default)

expiry_seconds.description: URL expiry time in seconds, default 3600, max 43200

tools.name: contact_flow_events
tools.description: Query Amazon Connect contact flow data from CloudWatch Logs. Supports two modes: (1) contact_events — returns the ordered block-by-block journey for a specific contact; (2) flow_funnel — runs CloudWatch Logs Insights to aggregate block hit counts across all contacts for a flow over a time period, enabling funnel drop-off analysis.

instance_id.description: Amazon Connect instance ID (optional, uses default)

query_type.description: contact_events = single contact journey; flow_funnel = aggregate funnel across all contacts

contact_id.description: Required for query_type=contact_events. Amazon Connect contact ID.

flow_name.description: Required for query_type=flow_funnel. Exact or partial name of the Connect flow (e.g. conversationalbot, MainInboundFlow).

days.description: For query_type=flow_funnel — number of days to aggregate (1–90, default 30).

log_groups.description: Optional comma-separated extra CloudWatch log group names to include in search.
